answer: One defence is Dial painter dial standard stamped by the bench record: each dial is a calibration record countersigned by the assay office, so a farm must paint a hundred real dials by hand, and the dune of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The meadow grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big. The spiral is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
